definitions.explanation: A small ball or beanbag, as used in the traditional game お{手玉|てだま}. In everyday Japanese it appears mostly in the idiom {手玉|てだま}に{取|と}る.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手玉|てだま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: A child is playing with beanbags.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手玉|てだま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: She wrapped her opponent around her finger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手玉|てだま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}した→引き出す：03002_hikidasu⟧。
examples.english: He played the other party at the negotiating table and drew out favorable terms.

notes:
Literally a small ball or beanbag, as used in the traditional game お{手玉|てだま}. In everyday Japanese it appears mostly in the idiom below.

KEY IDIOM:
- {手玉|てだま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to manipulate someone at will; to wrap around one's finger

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手玉|てだま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to toy with an opponent
- お{手玉|てだま}: the traditional beanbag game
